title: Word to PDF – Convert DOCX to PDF Online Free, No Upload
description: Convert a Word document to PDF in your browser: pages as the Word viewer shows them, with text you can still select and search. Free, no upload.
heading: Word to PDF
subtitle: Save a Word document as a PDF, page by page, with text you can still select and search; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert DOCX to PDF online without Word: the document is laid out the way this site's Word viewer shows it, with Word's own page size and page breaks, headers, footers, tables and pictures, then saved as PDF pages. Each page carries its text, so the PDF can be searched and copied, Arabic included. Works with .docx, .dotx, .docm and OpenDocument .odt files. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Searchable PDF
features.text: The pages carry their text, so it can be selected, searched and copied in any PDF reader.

features.title: Word's pages
features.text: Word's page size and the page breaks it saved are kept, with headers, footers, tables and pictures.

stepsTitle: How to convert Word to PDF

steps.title: Choose your document
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .docx or .odt file on the page.

steps.title: Check and download
steps.text: The preview shows the first pages; download the PDF.

handles: Headers, footers, page numbers, tables, lists and pictures.
Arabic and English, each in its own direction.

limits: The pages follow this site's Word viewer, which is close to Word but not identical; fonts your browser doesn't have are replaced.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Will it look exactly like Word?
faq.answer: Close, not identical: the layout follows this site's Word viewer, and fonts your browser doesn't have are replaced. Open the file in the Word viewer to see how it will come out.

faq.question: Can I search the text of the PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. Each page carries its text, so it can be selected, searched and copied, Arabic included.

faq.question: Does it work with .doc files?
faq.answer: No. Old .doc files can't be read; save them as .docx in Word or LibreOffice first.

faq.question: Can I edit the PDF afterwards?
faq.answer: You can add text, shapes and signatures with Edit PDF; to change the words themselves, edit the Word file and convert it again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I convert a Word document to PDF without Word?
faq.answer: Without Word, a .docx file can be saved as PDF by any app that opens Word documents, such as Google Docs, LibreOffice or Pages on a Mac. In OpenAnyDoc, choose the .docx file and download the PDF, with Word's page size, page breaks and searchable text; the file is converted in your browser and never uploaded.
